costumes.description:
Maxwell costume.
Obtained from a Mission Pass.

lines.text: How about we go and run some tests together?
You're a most interesting subject to observe.
All right, what's next?

I'll figure you out one day.
But before that, thank you for your concern, and your support.
I always enjoy running tests with you.
Cutey, we'll have to take our experiments to the next level in the future.

Huh. What are you sitting around for?
I hadn't pegged you for a couch potato.

Wow, I have to say, it's amusing being observed by you.
Do you plan on doing this often in the future?
The power station is chock full of research subjects. And I love it!
Want to come up to the power station? I need some help with an experiment I'm running.
If we yield enough positive results here, we'll be able to survive without depending on the Ark. Who knows, we may even be able to build our own Ark!
I've got some testing to do that's pretty interesting, wanna come help out?
Great, attribute up!
Not bad. Where did you get all these from?
Nikkes' bodies are so fascinating. It's incredible how they can be augmented using such materials.
Wow, a gift? I'm so happy!
I love it. Thank you!
A gift? Are you trying to get on my good side?
You are quite fascinating, Cutey. So many areas worth exploring.

My feelings for you are much stronger than before.
But what about my power, is it growing as well?
I find you more and more lovely with each passing day.
Well, let's go then.
You called, Cutey?
OK, let's go.
Finally, a battle.
Time for a test!
Let's see how strong I've become.
Let's go, My Cutey!
Need more ammo.
Reloading.
Interesting.
Cutey!
Max power! Go!
How long can you withstand the hail of bullets?
Easy peasy.
Come on, fight harder!
Neutralized.
Ow!
Damn it.
Hmph.
Hehe... Looks like I'm not all I was cracked up to be...
All clear. A successful experiment indeed!
